cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(App LANGUAGES C CXX)

# Generated by @weft-ui/vite. This project is yours: edit it freely; builds
# only rewrite weft/, which holds the generated views and the bundle, links
# the Weft shell and defines weft_app().
add_subdirectory(weft)

add_executable(app main.cpp)
weft_app(app)

# UI tests: `ctest --test-dir build` on a desktop session.
enable_testing()
add_executable(ui_tests tests/UITests.cpp)
weft_app(ui_tests)
add_test(NAME ui COMMAND ui_tests)

add_executable(screenshots tests/screenshots.cpp)
weft_app(screenshots)
